newsitem.title: UK: John Lewis says UK store sales up touch over 5 pct.
newsitem.headline: John Lewis says UK store sales up touch over 5 pct.

text.p: The John Lewis Partnership said sales in its UK department stores rose a little more than five percent in the week to to December 21, compared with the same week a year earlier.
That increase was in line with sales seen the week before, a John Lewis spokesman said.
Full figures for sales in the week to December 21 and this week will be released next Friday, the spokesman said.
He added that last week saw "particularly pleasing" sales in furnishings and said John Lewis stores had remained busy right up to Christmas Eve (December 24).
